caption: Forced selling is a research trigger and a timing input. It does not change intrinsic value, and the average post-spin excess return has compressed as the trade became known. A spread without a filed formula is a headline.
definition: A separation hands a security to holders who did not choose it, or offers one at a discount to holders who must decide. The register holds the filed terms; the flow model says who must sell, how much, and until when.
